profile.summary:

- Bachelor, Computer Engineer in Venezuela ( 1997 – 2003 )

positions.description: Devops Admin responsible for the design, implementation, problem resolution and automatization of services using Open Source solutions

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Specialized consulting focused on:

- J2EE Application Servers (Apache Tomcat, JBoss AS, WAS)
- Web Servers (Apache HTTP, IHS)
- Unix and Linux Servers (Red Hat, Debian, Solaris)
- Database Servers (Oracle, mysql)
- Open source applications (alfresco, awstats, bind, cacti, cas, liferay, nagios, nfs server, openldap, openssl, postfix, pure-ftp, samba server, sympa, syslog)
- J2EE Proprietary applications (Maximo, Fatwire)
- Network balancers (keepalived, lvs, F5 BIG-IP, Cisco CSS)
- Scripting (Bash, Python, Perl, Java, Javascript, C)
